pro_onboarding.q_language: Which language do you want IASHARK in?
pro_onboarding.language_help: The site, your Pro space, your emails and your Telegram bot all switch to this language.
pro_onboarding.not_available_title: Not available in your country yet
pro_onboarding.not_available_text: We never show you an operator that isn't licensed where you live: no bookmaker, no odds, no daily programme, no alerts. Your competitions and bet types already work.
pro_onboarding.competitions_help: For information only: at the end of your daily programme we list their matches (with the link to the analysis), and the next morning their results. The bets are the same for everyone.
pro_onboarding.q_markets: Which bet types do you prefer?
pro_onboarding.markets_help: We highlight them in the Gap Detector and in your accumulator. The bet IASHARK picks never changes.
pro_onboarding.markets_none: None ticked = all of them, in the usual order.
pro_onboarding.alert_programme_help: Every day, the programme's bets with the best odds at your bookmakers.
pro_onboarding.alert_cotes: The odds of your bets move
pro_onboarding.send_time_help: Paris time. A bet is never sent after its match has started.

pro_perso.highlight_note: They come first in the Gap Detector and your accumulator.
pro_perso.empty: Pick your competitions and bet types: they'll come first here.

compte_page.language_hint: Used for the site, your emails and your Telegram bot.
compte_page.vip_detail: Included in your Pro subscription: on every day with a programme, it reaches you privately on Telegram, in your language, with your alerts and debriefs. No channel to join: one click opens your IASHARK bot and links your account, that’s all.
compte_page.vip_already: Your account is already linked: your Pro messages arrive on Telegram, privately, in your chat with the IASHARK bot.
compte_page.vip_not_ready: Your Pro messages on Telegram (private) are coming very soon. Come back in a few days.
compte_page.vip_error: We can't create your link right now. Try again in a few minutes.
